items.title: Fixed window vs sliding window: limit ke edge par double requests kyun nikal jaati hain
items.one_idea: A fixed window rate limiter keeps one counter per time block and starts a fresh count each window, so a client can send a full limit just before the edge and another just after (up to 2x in a short span); a sliding window fixes this, exactly by logging every request timestamp (memory grows with traffic) or approximately by weighting the previous window's count (two numbers per client).
items.spoken_hook: Limit 100 per minute: दो सेकंड में 200 कैसे?
items.hook_formula: direct_question: an everyday-looking limit set against a number that breaks it, answered by the next line
